newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edges up but traders await Nov demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edges up but traders await Nov demand.

text.p: NWE naphtha edged up on Friday tracking crude's rally, but traders said the physical market was quiet ahead of November demand.

Traders were awaiting a conclusion to the talks with Algerian state oil company Sonatrach and contract holders for November condensate prices, and what impact that may have on end-user demand for naphtha.
Nov swaps traded at $217.50/$218.50, up $1.50 from Thursday, and Dec bids were up $2 to $213, traders said.
Cargoes were up $2 to $222/$224 cif NWE with some demand seen for heavier grades for making gasoline.
